raw: One time I was bowling and took my turn out of order. The person who was supposed to go next was still choosing a ball, and I went ahead. I got a strike, too—but then it came up under the wrong name on the screen. That was the embarrassing part, looking up and realizing I’d just bowled somebody else’s turn. A strike is something you want your name next to, and there I was noticing the name only after I’d thrown the ball. Meanwhile, the person whose turn it actually was was still picking one out.
